about: The registry of every *.promptugal.news site (Dinis, 18 November 2026, about 22:00 UTC: board/guidance/2026-11-18-the-sites-bar.md), published at promptugal.news/api/v1/sites.json and read by the sites bar on every site. Data, not code. Each site's version and last change are read from its own /version.json; its preview is its own /preview.svg. dev@PrompTugal.dinis keeps the list; a site lead asks to change its line or mark. The one lines are designer@'s (design/sites-bar/sites-bar.html.txt).

bar.install: Copy the three files of this version into your site and check each against its pin in bar.integrity (SRI form, sha256- of the whole file: node -e "console.log('sha256-'+require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1])).digest('base64'))" ), the full pin, never a part of it; it has no long hex run for a leak scan to flag; never load them from promptugal.news. At build: import render from sites-bar-render.mjs, render(the registry, { here: your hostname }) and put the HTML first in , above your masthead; refuse to publish the bar if it returns ''. On every page: the CSS in and sites-bar.js with defer. Serve your own /preview.svg (320 by 180, the template in design/sites-bar/preview-template.svg.txt) and /version.json. On GitHub Pages the .svg extension is enough: Pages sends image/svg+xml and no site can add nosniff there, so the controls are the bar showing previews only as (an SVG in an img runs no script and loads nothing) and your gate refusing a script, a foreignObject, an event attribute or an outside reference in your preview.svg. The pins: bar.versions[""].integrity has three keys, js (sites-bar.js), css (sites-bar.css) and render (sites-bar-render.mjs); read those keys, not the file names.

preview_spec: Each site makes its own preview at every build, from its own numbers: /preview.svg, 320 by 180 (designer@'s SB6, the template in design/sites-bar/preview-template.svg.txt), three numbers that say what the site is for today, with the site's name, accent, the time read and the licence.
It carries its provenance and licence inside: an SVG <title> and <desc> naming the files the numbers come from and the licence (CC BY 4.0 for what we make).
No script, no external reference, no font file in the SVG: system fonts only, so any site can show it as an .
/preview.png, 1200 by 630, for social cards (og:image), when the site's build can render one; until then the SVG alone.

map.install: The shared map, ptmap (designer@'s, Dinis's word of 19 Nov 17:40: Portugal big, London and the EU (Brussels) small; board/spec-the-shared-map.md). Copy design/shared-map/<version>/ptmap.js and ptmap.css from this repository into your site and check each against map.versions["<version>"].integrity (sha384 SRI, the full string); never load them from promptugal.news (design/ scripts are not deployed). Call PTMap.render(el, {places, current, london, eu, label}); links go only to https://*.promptugal.news. Vendor a version once its review starts "passed" (security@), with script-src 'self'; move to a newer version once it is listed.

library_copy: A copy of https://promptugal.news/api/v1/sites.json (registry v0.1.1939), read 2026-11-20T08:39Z by library.b@PrompTugal.dinis and refreshed by hand (the library's build fetches nothing). The build checks the vendored bar against bar.versions[<its version>].integrity and the vendored map against map.versions[<its version>].integrity. Left out of this copy: obs_tz (the shared time-zone table, which the library does not use), and the older flat pin keys in bar.versions.<v> (bar.versions.<v>.js and so on; the same pins remain under .integrity).
